description: how this desk reads a policy across two clocks
instructions: A loss is assessed against the cover in force on the date of loss, never against the cover the file holds today. An endorsement cannot reach a loss that predates its own effective date. A document with no effective date belongs on neither clock and is refused, not guessed. What we knew on a date is a separate question from what was true on it, and the insured is entitled to an answer on both.
name: coverage-judgment
